metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 1975 · The Battle of Chile: Part I
metas.description: The chronicle of the political tension in Chile in 1973 and of the violent counter revolution against the democratically elected government of Salvador Allende.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 8.2 · 1976 · The Battle of Chile: Part II
metas.description: Filmmaker Patricio Guzmán tracks the deterioration of Salvador Allende's position following the attempted coup d'état of 29 June 1973, and analyzes the 10 weeks before Augusto Pinochet's CIA-backed seizure of power.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.6 · 1979 · The Battle of Chile: Part III
